irregularities.title: 144 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 2 clubs (JAX, NO)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
